notes: Modified cash basis county, governmental funds only. Statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of the fund statement (pp4-5, Total column p5); fund balances and Cash and Deposits from p7 (beginning cash not printed, so beginning_cash null; beginning fund balance 4,754,187). Debt Service 91,490 split into Principal Retirement 85,000 and Interest Payments 6,490 from the Road Fund schedule (p15). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (p7) because its total equals the Statement of Net Position (p1: Cash and Deposits 4,945,209 + Designated Deposits 26,318 = 4,971,527; Restricted 342,074, Unrestricted 4,629,453). Detail: Schedules 1-4 (pp8-20); Schedule 5 (fund balance changes, incl. fiduciary funds), Schedule 6 combined statement (p23) and Schedule 7 budget-and-actual by fund type (pp24-25) not recorded to avoid double counting. Schedule lines with a blank actual cell were skipped (e.g. Road Federal budget 500,000, Environmental Trust - Bowman fund, Inheritance Tax operating/capital budgets, several capital outlay budgets). The Emergency Manager section total is printed as 'Total Diversion Program' 9,832. Transfers: in 1,476,186 = General 274,645 + Road 1,192,738 + other 8,803; out = General 1,109,765 + Inheritance Tax 267,497 + other 98,924. Read pages 1-26 of 26
